about: When a mystical phenomenon appears, drawing the world’s finest young Shinobi into a parallel dimension, everything they know about life and death turns upside down. Taken to a strange world resembling a warm summer island, the girls find themselves tested both physically and mentally as they're pushed to their limits to prepare for the unforeseen challenges ahead.

Featuring the biggest roster of fighters to date, SENRAN KAGURA ESTIVAL VERSUS is overflowing with explosive ninja moves, outrageous clothes-clearing combos and a scintillating storyline. All previous favourites return, with new moves and upgraded skills along with a host of new characters, further expanding the roster with new challenges and techniques to master.

As well as the plethora of single player content, SENRAN KAGURA ESTIVAL VERSUS also features online multiplayer matches, allowing up to 10 PlayStation®4 players to battle it out at once in game modes such as Shinobi Deathmatch, Understorm & Capture the Bra.
This product supports the following languages: English
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
